intro: Aeyaz is a Dubai-based Director of Photography, available to work worldwide, specialising in high-end TV commercials and branded films.
body:
His work spans the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Africa and the USA. In 2023 he was listed among the Top 3 Cinematographers at the Loeries Awards for the Middle East & Africa.

With more than 15 years of experience across VFX, post-production and cinematography, his background as a VFX supervisor shapes his approach to visually complex productions.

He has shot campaigns for Pepsi, Samsung, Philips, Saudia Airlines, Dubai Tourism, Coca-Cola, KFC, Nespresso, Etisalat and Saudi Telecom, often working with international celebrities, athletes and sports personalities.

In 2025 he made his feature film debut as Director of Photography on Sarkeet, a Malayalam-language film.
